purpose: Teach: 東南アジア/四国/採取/タンパク質/探査/単身/誤差/交易

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本気で、絶対、東南アジア、絶対、の経済、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Your paper on Southeast Asian economics was genuinely impressive. The depth of your research really struck me.
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Slight lean forward in the voice. Genuine admiration without flattery. Eye contact in the tone. Measured pace, landing softly on the compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、四国、絶対、の伝統工芸、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to make the research on Shikoku's traditional crafts as thorough as I could.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude underneath a careful surface. Slight hesitation before committing to the compliment. Steady voice, not too fast. A small lift at the end—genuine relief at being understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地質サンプルの、本気で、絶対、採取、絶対、現場、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the geological sampling and field methodology was particularly thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself at first. Then gaze settles on Sakura. Slower pace, weighing each word. No rushing. The tone says she's really seen the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。植物の、本気で、絶対、タンパク質、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to make sure the plant protein structures were examined carefully and thoroughly in my analysis.
lines.style: Earnest nod in the voice. Slight tension—wanting to match her teacher's seriousness. Not defensive, but careful. Pace steady and even. A small dip at the end, like setting something down respectfully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 深海の、本気で、絶対、探査、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your approach to the deep-sea exploration technology section showed real maturity in your thinking.
lines.style: Engaged, almost surprised by her own observation. Warmer now. Eyes brightening in the voice. Pace picks up slightly with genuine interest. Landing with quiet conviction on the main point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。研究者の、本気で、絶対、単身、絶対、赴任、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I really appreciated learning about researchers who took single postings to remote sites. That part was meaningful to me.
lines.style: More open than before. Still earnest, but less guarded. A real smile in the voice now. Pace slightly easier. Vulnerability showing through—something personal touched her in the research.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 測定の、本気で、絶対、誤差、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And you didn't gloss over the measurement error margins—that kind of precision matters.
lines.style: Nod of recognition in the voice. Lighter now, almost conspiratorial. Shared understanding between teacher and serious student. Quick and clean delivery. Genuine respect at the core.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、交易、絶対、ルート、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to trace the ancient trade routes with as much accuracy as possible. It all felt connected somehow.
lines.style: Soft finish. Guard down completely now. Thoughtful, reflective. Pace slows slightly at the end. The connection she found in the research—genuine, almost wondering. Trailing off gently, letting the thought breathe.
